name: Factorio Power Poles
description: Power symbols that wire themselves to nearby poles on the same net, with drooping power lines.

actions.name: Update power lines
actions.description: Wire up every Factorio power pole in the schematic and redraw its power lines

actions.name: Live power lines (toggle)
actions.description: Keep power lines up to date while you edit; run again to stop

actions.name: Remove power lines
actions.description: Delete all pole sprites and power lines drawn by this plugin (the poles stay)
